# Release Status

This is the canonical editable QMD source for the Tools engineering design
manual. It is a governance scaffold, not a released engineering manual. The
file-level module inventory is complete for its declared tracked-source
denominator. TOOLS-D4 registers one model-conditioned D-plane calculation and
one swing/Rate-of-Closure textbook exemplar with exact source, consumer, test,
fixture, equation, unit, and limitation traceability. The markerless-mocap
exemplar remains explicitly blocked because its authority PR is unmerged and no
markerless module exists on this exact source base. Release remains blocked by
TOOLS-D5 through TOOLS-D9 and outstanding D4 approvals. Generated HTML, LaTeX,
PDF, and DOCX artifacts are reproducible engineering records under TOOLS-D2,
but none is approved for publication or engineering use.
